verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms a first-party llms.txt at docs.stripe.com (HTTP 200) whose content gives agent-directed instructions. Issuing pages are also served as markdown (e.g. issuing.md returned HTTP 200), so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-readable docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs, and confirmation of how much of the Issuing section llms.txt indexes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
